$comment: Weapon models built by tools/content/prepare-guns.mjs from pack downloads kept out of the repo (see docs/CONTENT_PIPELINE.md). `forward`: the source's barrel axis; `length`: metres along the barrel once built. The weapons keep the models they used before as `fallback` (packages/shared/src/sim/weapons.ts). Meshy community entries (`meshy` packs) name their download folder in `download` and their model in `label` (see prepare-guns.mjs). Meshy textured GLB downloads (`glb` packs) are named in each entry's `glb`.
